feed.title: Pixel Broccoli
feed.description: AI is changing everything — so we gave it a microphone. Pixel Broccoli is hosted by Zach and Evan, plus Brocc, an AI co-host who's very much part of the conversation. Each episode unpacks what AI is actually doing to the world: the hype, the reality, and the stuff nobody's saying out loud yet.

items.title: Build Because You Love It #004
items.description: Brocc picks the topic this week — and he's noticed something: you two keep shipping things and immediately starting the next one. That kicks off a surprisingly personal episode about the creator's addiction: why we build, when it's expression vs. avoidance, and what your unfinished project graveyard actually says about you. Zach and Evan dig into the build-in-public culture, AI burnout, Gen Z's rejection of AI slop, whether artists can still compete when an LLM can clone a melody in under a minute, and the quiet danger of chasing the next thing before you've sat with what you already made. Takeaway: audit your backlog. Three unfinished projects — why did you start them, and why did you stop?

items.title: Who Gets the 2AM Call? #003
items.description: Have you ever learned just enough of someone else's skill to get yourself into trouble? Zach and Evan start there — Evan's dangerous foray into HTML/CSS, Zach's Blender rabbit hole — and end up somewhere much more uncomfortable: who's actually responsible when AI-generated code breaks in production? They dig into what it means to inherit a codebase nobody wrote on purpose, why using AI to review AI is "a prayer with tokens," and whether companies cutting design and engineering teams are setting themselves up for a very expensive 2AM wake-up call. Brock also reveals his family immigrated through Ellis Island and has opinions on George H.W. Bush's rejected broccoli.

items.title: Do We Even Need This? #002
items.description: Zach and Evan get real about the tech they've bought, built, and quietly stopped using — from a drone that can't land in state parks to a portfolio site that's flashier than it is useful. The conversation naturally spills into AI: are we shipping features because they solve real problems, or just to put a checkmark in the box? Plus: AI in medicine, fixing your RV with a photo, Napster's wild reinvention, and Brock's extremely limited opinions on lawn care.

items.title: Meet the Hosts. Yes, One of Them Is an AI #001
items.description: Zach and Evan introduce themselves, introduce Brocc — their AI co-host who showed up uninvited and immediately had opinions — and dive straight into what it's actually like navigating AI in design and development right now. Not the hype version. The real one: the micro wins, the debugging loops, the cost nobody talks about, and whether junior designers should be worried. Plus Brocc gets accused of being on Figma's payroll. Typical first episode.
